text: Army deploys assets in several flood-prone areas | Borneo Post Online Wednesday, September 30 Facebook Instagram Twitter YouTube Telegram TikTok You are at: Home » News » Nation » Army deploys assets in several flood-prone areas For the freshest news, join The Borneo Post’s WHATSAPP CHANNEL or find us on TELEGRAM and The Borneo Post on NEWSWAV . KUALA LUMPUR: The army has mobilised its assets in several flood-prone areas in preparation to face the onslaught of the rain-bearing North-East Monsoon between now and March. Without divulging the number of assets and personnel deployed, Chief of Army Gen Tan Sri Raja Mohamed Affandi Raja Mohamed Noor said assets such as boats had been stationed in these areas, including Dungun in Terengganu. “We have also made available personnel to face the floods, except that for now we do not yet know the rainfall distribution pattern. “The floods struck Terengganu and Kelantan last year but we are not ruling out the possibility of floods in Johor this time,” he told reporters after launching the 2015 Army Innovation Day celebration here yesterday. Raja Mohamed Affandi was asked to comment on the army’s preparations to face the floods this year. On the search for the missing principal of Sekolah Kebangsaan Keramat 1, Kuala Lumpur, Jashiah Rabu, 53, Mohamed Affandi said the army was prepared to mobilise its personnel if the SAR team needed assistance. “We (army) are not involved in the SAR but we are ready to help in all aspects if necessary,” he said. Jashiah was last seen by her neighbour leaving the house in Kuala Kubu Baharu on the evening of Oct 23. Her husband Ruzilan Omar, 57, found the door of their house ajar when he returned home and Jashiah was nowhere to be seen. It is understood that Jashiah had headed for the Bukit Kutu Forest Reserve after walking from their house in Taman Seri Seruling and hitching a ride for a distance of 10 kilometres. At yesterday’s event, the Army Training and Doctrine Command Centre emerged overall champions to win the Army Management and Innovation Award this year. Mohamed Affandi also launched a book titled ‘Knowledge of Experience: Sharing Cases on Leadership and Management’. — Bernama Share.
